useCases: Plan a sprint on a three-column task board.
Ask the agent to create a task, edit its notes or move it to Done.
requirements: Tasks are saved locally for this Nextbrowser account. No external service account is required.
example: List my unfinished tasks, then move the release checklist to In progress.
